setup.telegram: In Telegram, open @BotFather, send /newbot, follow the prompts, then paste the token it gives you into Token below.
setup.discord: In the Discord Developer Portal, create an application, add a Bot, and copy its token into Token below.
setup.feishu: On the Feishu Open Platform, create an app, enable its bot capability, then copy the App ID and App Secret below.
setup.dingtalk: On the DingTalk Open Platform, create an app, enable Stream Mode, then copy the Client ID and Client Secret below.
setup.slack: Create a Slack app, turn on Socket Mode, then paste the Bot Token (xoxb-) and App Token (xapp-) below.
setup.wecom: In your WeCom admin console, create a bot and copy its bot ID and secret below.
setup.weixin: No signup needed. Enable it and restart the gateway, then click Scan to log in to show the QR code.
setup.qq: On the QQ Bot Platform, create a bot, then copy its App ID and Secret below.
setup.whatsapp: Start the local WhatsApp bridge, enable it and restart the gateway, then click Scan to log in.
setup.matrix: In your Matrix client (Element: Settings -> Help -> Access Token), copy your access token and user ID below.
setup.mochat: Get your MoChat claw token from the MoChat console and paste it below.
setup.email: Enter your mailbox IMAP and SMTP settings. For Gmail or Outlook, create an app password and use it here.
